canonicalTeaching.requirement: Selection/enrichment, population expansion and activation state are different outcomes with distinct measurements.

evidence.supportingExcerpt: Expansion compares absolute counts of a specified living population at stated points in a culture process. Enrichment or selection changes mixture composition, while activation changes cellular state. Measurements need a consistent cell definition, viability basis, sampling method and interval. Cell concentration can change with dilution or volume, and a higher fraction can result from losing other cells rather than producing more intended cells.
Cell expansion increases the number of a defined group of living cells outside the body. Selecting cells or activating them answers a different question.

evidence.supportingExcerpt: Cryopreservation manages cooling, water movement, ice formation, concentrated solutes and warming injury; it does not literally stop all molecular motion. Cryoprotectant formulation, exposure, freezing, storage, transport, thawing and permitted holding times form a defined process. Some materials are handled fresh. A temperature log documents conditions, while stability evidence and the quality system determine the consequences of a deviation. Neither a shipper nor a barcode guarantees viable, functional material or the correct recipient.

Panch's 2019 retrospective single-centre analysis covered 158 autologous CAR T-cell products from six trials and additional donor experiments. It did not detect differences in selected manufacturing or clinical measures under its tested conditions, while molecular and cellular changes were observed. This does not demonstrate universal equivalence of fresh and frozen material or interchangeability of starting-material and final-product freezing.

The labels captured on 9 November 2026 illustrate why a single temperature or formulation is misleading. YESCARTA describes 5% DMSO with 2.5% human albumin, whereas KYMRIAH describes 7.5% (v/v) DMSO. These are particular labelled formulations, not a general recipe for other cells, research specimens, RNA or carrier products.

Research banking and clinical cell-product storage have different intended uses and acceptance requirements. An excursion requires documented investigation, relevant stability evidence and a disposition by the authorised programme. Identity records, custody records, temperature logs, test samples and final-product decisions remain distinct.
